THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-0r.anc: A child. Here, at the top of my Spire.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-1r.cha: I saved this one for the top! You might wanna cover your ears!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-0r.a: Still playing to an audience, Regina?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-1r.c: Every good show needs a villain. Places, please!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-0r.a: You left your island to climb my Spire.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-1r.c: I left it in good hands. I came to make sure this place never reaches them.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-0r.an: Grand Master. Five years on the road, and still you climb.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-1r.ch: Almost done. One fight, then the road home.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-YAE.0-0r.anci: Guuji. You read my Spire like a book.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-YAE.0-1r.char: And I've reached the last page. Do keep up; I would hate to edit you out.
